issues.claim: DROP expands to 'Delete Request and Opt-Out Platform'
issues.section: Background: DROP and the Delete Act
issues.issue: Official CPPA page styles the acronym as 'Delete Request and Opt-out Platform' (lowercase 'o' in 'Opt-out'). Report uses 'Opt-Out' with capital O. Stylistic, not substantive.
issues.suggested_fix: Optionally align capitalization with official CPPA styling ('Opt-out Platform').
